chain3.v16m: The set $|\operatorname{Im} z| < \pi/2$ and the line $\operatorname{Im}z=0.8$ (dashed outline), and their image under $F(z)=\left((e^{z}-1)/(e^{z}+1)\right)^{2}$ (checkerboard), joined by the homotopy $H_t$, $0\le t\le 3$, that runs the steps in turn ($H_t=H^{(k)}_{t-k+1}$ on $k-1\le t\le k$): for $f_{1}$, the zoom homotopy ${H^{(1)}_{s}}(z)=(e^{sz}-1)/s+s$ for $0<s\le 1$, ${H^{(1)}_{0}}(z)=z$; for $f_{2}$, the elliptic M\"obius transformations ${H^{(2)}_{s}}$ that fix $p=i$ and $q=-i$, with ${H^{(2)}_{s}}'(p)=e^{-\pi i s/2}$; for $f_{3}$, the homotopy ${H^{(3)}_{s}}(w_{2})=w_{2}^{1+s}$ (principal branch). Curves are the paths $t\mapsto H_t(z)$ of 1 boundary point, from $z$ (circle) to $F(z)$ (dot), with an arrowhead at $t=1/2,\ 3/2,\ 5/2$ (the middle of each step) and a bar at $t=1,\ 2$, where one step ends and the next begins. Regions are shaded by a checkerboard of squares of side $1$ in the $z$-plane, carried by the map. Dashed boundaries do not belong to the sets.
